platform.name: CreatorBridge
platform.description: CreatorBridge is a specialized commercial marketplace connecting brands and agencies with certified generative AI creators. It streamlines creator discovery, AI-assisted campaign brief generation, transparent 7-factor compatibility matching, portfolio showcases with high-definition video playback, and a mathematically explainable trust and reliability scoring system.
core_actors: Creators: Generative AI artists, prompt directors, video animators, and technical designers who showcase portfolios, apply to commercial briefs, and complete creative deliverables.
Brands: Commercial companies, marketing managers, and creative agencies who create campaigns, generate AI briefs, discover verified creators, and commission AI content.
Judges / Platform Administrators: Evaluators who review platform health, trust cases, and verification audits.

modules.title: Creator Onboarding & Diagnostic Assessment
modules.summary: Creators undergo a comprehensive diagnostic assessment covering generative AI tools, prompt engineering, multi-modal workflows, and commercial delivery standards to earn certified badges.
details: Diagnostic Survey: A structured multi-question assessment evaluating tool proficiency (Runway, Midjourney, Kling, ComfyUI, etc.), technical prompt control, and production timelines.
Adaptive Branching: Questions dynamically adjust based on the creator's declared primary medium (video animation, cinematic stills, 3D graphics, voiceover).
Verification Badges: Successful completion earns verified skill badges displayed on the public creator profile.
Local Fallback: In development and demo environments, the assessment engine uses a curated deterministic question bank (`question_bank.py`) ensuring zero downtime.

modules.title: Creator Portfolios & Media Playback
modules.summary: Creators showcase high-definition generative video and image assets with native 16:9 responsive playback and tool metadata.
details: Media Formats: Supports MP4 video reels and high-resolution PNG/WebP images.
Responsive 16:9 Player: Custom HTML5 video player with play/pause, volume control, time scrub, and automatic fallback posters.
Tool Attribution: Each portfolio piece displays the specific AI tools utilized (e.g., Runway Gen-3, Midjourney v6.1, Topaz Video AI, ElevenLabs).
Demo Showcase Assets: Pre-rendered commercial advertising campaigns (Skincare, Technical Outerwear, Haute Couture, Premium Matcha) are bundled locally for instant playback with zero latency.

modules.title: Brand Campaign Brief Builder & AI Assistance
modules.summary: Brands create structured commercial briefs manually or with AI generation powered by OpenAI gpt-4o-mini or deterministic creative synthesis.
details: AI Brief Synthesis: Converts a short concept into a structured brief containing title, description, target audience, format requirements, timeline, and deliverables.
Section Regeneration: Brands can selectively refine or regenerate specific sections (such as creative directions or key themes).
Validation Engine: Briefs must pass completeness checks (valid title, budget ceiling, clear deliverables) before being published to the creator marketplace.
Fallback Synthesis: When the OpenAI API key is unavailable, `deterministic_intelligence.py` provides high-fidelity creative templates so brands can always draft campaigns.

modules.title: Creator Discovery & Filtering Engine
modules.summary: Brands can search and filter the verified creator roster using tool filters, match compatibility percentages, hourly rates, and availability.
details: AI Tool Filtering: Robust tool-matching engine (`toolMatching.ts`) normalizes tool names, version numbers, and synonym clusters (e.g. 'Kling' matches 'Kling AI', 'SDXL' matches 'Stable Diffusion', 'Runway' matches 'Runway Gen-3 Alpha').
Match Compatibility Filter: Filter creators by minimum match percentage (e.g., >= 75%, >= 85%). Missing or uncomputed scores never falsely pass positive thresholds.
Hourly Rate Filter: Refine creators by hourly rate ceilings (e.g., <= $140/hr).
Availability Filter: View creators marked 'Available Now' for immediate campaign assignment.

modules.title: 7-Factor Compatibility Matching Engine
modules.summary: CreatorBridge matches creators with campaign briefs using an explainable 7-dimension weighted algorithm.
details: 1. Skills & Portfolio Match (30% weight): Tool proficiency and relevance of portfolio examples to the brief's deliverables.
2. Niche & Category Relevance (20% weight): Alignment with the brand's industry (e.g. Beauty & Skincare, Technical Gear, Fashion, Beverage).
3. Format & Platform Expertise (15% weight): Track record in target aspect ratios (9:16 vertical, 16:9 cinematic) and channels (TikTok, YouTube, Digital OOH).
4. Target Audience Alignment (10% weight): Demographic and stylistic resonance with the campaign's target market.
5. Budget Compatibility (10% weight): Match between creator's hourly/project rates and the campaign reward pool.
6. Timeline & Availability (10% weight): Availability window matching the brand's milestone deadlines.
7. Brand/Creator Values & Preferences (5% weight): Shared creative ethos and non-discriminatory preferences.

modules.title: Transparent Trust, Reliability & Demerit System
modules.summary: CreatorBridge maintains platform honesty with a mathematically explainable trust score starting at 100 points.
details: Base Trust Score: Every account starts with a baseline score of 100 ('New - insufficient history' until confirmed milestone completion).
Incident Severities & Base Penalties: Minor (5 pts), Moderate (15 pts), Major (30 pts), Critical (50 pts).
Recurrence Multipliers: 1.0x (1st occurrence), 1.25x (2nd occurrence), 1.5x (3rd+ occurrence), capped at 50 points per single incident.
Score Recovery: Accounts recover +5 points per 90 consecutive days without confirmed violations (maximum +15 points per rolling year).
Non-Discriminatory Safeguards: The engine explicitly rejects demerits or complaints based on race, religion, gender, politics, or the legitimate use of AI.
Dispute & Case Workflow: Reports follow an audited lifecycle: Submitted -> Awaiting Evidence -> Under Review -> Confirmed or Dismissed -> Appealed / Overturned.

modules.title: AI Generation Studios & Zero-Cost Demo Architecture
modules.summary: The platform provides AI Generation Studios for images, video, and audio, configured by default in a zero-cost demo mode.
details: Zero-Cost Demo Mode: `VIDEO_GENERATION_MODE=demo` is active by default. Video generation dispatches instantly deliver high-definition MP4 clips without billable third-party API charges.
Supported AI Studios: Image Studio (OpenAI DALL-E 3), Video Studio (Runway Gen-3 Alpha Turbo adapter / Demo mode), Voice Studio (OpenAI TTS-1 / ElevenLabs adapter).
Resilient Fallbacks: When external provider keys are absent, creative studios and brief synthesis automatically execute local simulation engines without unhandled exceptions.

modules.title: Platform Navigation & Role-Based Authentication
modules.summary: CreatorBridge separates Brand and Creator experiences with strict role routing and anti-bot verification.
details: Portal Separation: Creators log in at `/auth/creator` and access `/creator/*`; Brands log in at `/auth/brand` and access `/brand/*`. Attempting to access the wrong portal redirects to the appropriate login page.

Human Verification: Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection is integrated on registration and login. For development and judge demos, Cloudflare official test keys (`1x00000000000000000000AA`) ensure 100% verification success.
Session Persistence: Dual-persistence stores profiles locally in SQLite (`backend/data/creatorbridge.db`) with JWT token serialization.

modules.title: Known Limitations & Demo Architecture
modules.summary: Honest overview of features that are currently simulated or in demo mode for hackathon evaluation.
details: Simulated Payments & Escrow: Milestone budget escrow and creator reward disbursements are simulated via internal state machine transitions (Stripe is not currently connected to live banking).
In-App Notifications: Email notifications via Resend are an optional placeholder; all current alerts, badge issuances, and milestone updates appear in-app.
Read-Only Support Assistant: This support chatbot answers platform questions and troubleshooting queries only. It does not execute actions, modify user records, or answer off-topic queries.

faqs.question: How do I create a creator portfolio on CreatorBridge?
faqs.answer: Sign in to the Creator Portal at `/auth/creator`, navigate to 'Portfolio' in your sidebar, and click 'Add Portfolio Item'. You can upload MP4 video clips or high-resolution images, tag the AI tools you used (e.g. Runway, Midjourney, Kling), select your niche, and publish it to your public showcase.

faqs.question: How does a brand publish a campaign brief?
faqs.answer: Sign in to the Brand Portal at `/auth/brand`, navigate to 'Briefs', and click 'Create Brief'. You can enter your campaign requirements manually or click 'Generate with AI' to let our brief builder auto-structure the deliverables, target audience, format requirements, and timeline.

faqs.question: How does creator matching work?
faqs.answer: CreatorBridge uses an explainable 7-factor weighted algorithm: Skills & Portfolio Match (30%), Niche Relevance (20%), Format & Platform Expertise (15%), Target Audience Alignment (10%), Budget Compatibility (10%), Timeline & Availability (10%), and Brand/Creator Values (5%).

faqs.question: What AI tools can creators tag in their profiles?
faqs.answer: Creators can tag all major commercial generative AI tools, including Kling AI, Midjourney, Runway (Gen-3 Alpha), FLUX, Stable Diffusion (SDXL), ComfyUI, Topaz Video AI, Blender, Magnific AI, ElevenLabs, Adobe Photoshop / Firefly, Luma Dream Machine, Suno AI, ControlNet, and Unreal Engine 5.

faqs.question: Why does video generation complete so quickly in the demo?
faqs.answer: The platform is currently operating in `VIDEO_GENERATION_MODE=demo`. In this mode, generation jobs deliver pre-rendered commercial showcase assets with zero latency and zero billable API costs for smooth hackathon demonstration.

faqs.question: How do trust scores work and can they be recovered?
faqs.answer: Trust scores start at 100 points. Demerits range from Minor (5 pts) to Critical (50 pts) with recurrence multipliers. Accounts recover +5 points for every 90 consecutive days without confirmed violations (up to +15 pts per year). Complaints targeting race, religion, gender, or the legitimate use of AI are strictly prohibited.

faqs.question: Can this chatbot write code, do homework, or answer general trivia?
faqs.answer: No. I am specifically restricted to answering questions about CreatorBridge's platform features, workflows, creator portfolios, brand campaigns, matching algorithms, and troubleshooting. For general coding or trivia, please use general-purpose tools.
